strings.meta.title: pdff — Phatani, sintha, ndipo konzani PDF, Word, Excel kwa ufulu
strings.meta.description: Chida chaulere cha pa intaneti chophatikiza, kusintha, kuyanika, kugawa ndi kuteteza mafayilo anu a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ndi zithunzi. Palibe kulembetsa, mafayilo amachotsedwa nthawi yomweyo.
strings.meta.keywords: phatani pdf, sintha pdf, pdf kukhala word, word kukhala pdf, jpg kukhala pdf, pdf kukhala jpg, yanika pdf, gawani pdf, excel kukhala pdf, zida zaulere za pdf
strings.footer.text: Zaulere, palibe kulembetsa. Mafayilo anu amachotsedwa ntchito ikangotha.

strings.home.steps[0].text: Kokani mafayilo anu kapena asankheni pa foni yanu.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% zaulere
strings.seo.why[0].text: Palibe kulembetsa, palibe kirediti kadi, palibe chizindikiro chomwe chawonjezeredwa pazikalata zanu.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Palibe kulembetsa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Palibe akaunti yofunikira kupanga: tsegulani tsambali, gwetzani mafayilo anu, zatha.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Mafayilo anu amakhalabe anu
strings.seo.why[2].text: Amathandizidwa, ndiyeno n'kuchotsedwa nthawi yomweyo. Sitimasunga zikalata zanu kapena zomwe mwalemba.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Mtundu uliwonse
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, zithunzi, EPUB… kuchokera pa kompyuta kapena foni.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Inde. Chida chilichonse ndi chaulere, popanda chizindikiro kapena chilichonse chotsekedwa pansi pa kulembetsa. Palibe kirediti kadi yomwe imapemphedwa.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Ayi. Palibe kulembetsa, palibe adiresi ya imelo: mumagwiritsa ntchito zidazi nthawi yomweyo.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Ayi. Mafayilo anu amagwiritsidwa ntchito pazinthu zomwe mwapempha zokha, ndiyeno n'kuchotsedwa. Palibe amene amawerenga ndipo samagawidwa.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Inde. pdff imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa foni iliyonse, tabuleti kapena kompyuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), popanda chinthu choti muyike.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, zithunzi (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ndi zina zambiri.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Mukhoza kukonza mafayilo mpaka {files} nthawi imodzi, ndipo chikalata chopangidwa chikhoza kukhala ndi masamba mpaka {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Zinsinsi
strings.privacy.description: Momwe pdff imagwiritsira ntchito mafayilo anu: palibe akaunti, palibe chikalata chosungidwa, palibe zotsatsa ndi palibe kugulitsanso deta.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff imamveka m'njira yoti zikalata zanu zikhale zanu. Nayi m'mawu osavuta, zomwe zimachita mukayigwiritsa ntchito.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Mafayilo anu
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Amatumizidwa mwachinsinsi (HTTPS), amakonzedwa mokha, ndiyeno n'kuchotsedwa zotsatira zikangokhalapo. Mafayilo akuluakulu amadutsa kusungirako kwakanthawi pansi pa dzina losasintha ndipo amachotsedwa ntchito ikangotha; kuyeretsa kodzipereka kumachotsa chilichonse chomwe chingatsale pasanatha maola 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Palibe akaunti, palibe deta yaumwini
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff sipempha kulembetsa, adiresi ya imelo kapena kirediti kadi. Zikalata zanu sizimawerengedwa, kuwunikidwa, kugawidwa kapena kugwiritsidwa ntchito kuphunzitsa luntha lochita kupanga.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kuyeza omvera
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Timawerenga maulendo popanda kudziwika ndi popanda ma cookies (Vercel Web Analytics) kuti tiphunzire zida zomwe zili zothandiza. Palibe zotsatsa, palibe kutsatira kachitidwe ka webusaiti.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Ma cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie imodzi, yosankha: imakumbukira chiyankhulo chomwe mwasankha.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kusungira patsamba
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Tsambali limasungidwa ndi Vercel pa maseva ku Paris; kusintha kwa Word, Excel ndi PowerPoint kumayang'aniridwa ndi Render ku Frankfurt. Othandizawa amangogwira ntchito ndi mafayilo nthawi ya kusintha kokha.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Lumikizanani
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Funso kapena ndemanga? Tilankhule kuchokera patsamba la projekiti:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Phatani
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Phatizaninso mafayilo angapo (PDF, Word, zithunzi…) kukhala PDF imodzi, m'dongosolo lomwe mwasankha.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Phatani mafayilo a PDF pa intaneti kwa ufulu (Word, zithunzi, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Phatani PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ndi zithunzi kukhala PDF imodzi, m'dongosolo lomwe mukufuna. Zaulere, palibe kulembetsa, palibe chizindikiro, mafayilo amachotsedwa nthawi yomweyo.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Ikani zikalata zanu zonse m'fayilo imodzi: pdff imatenga ma PDF komanso zikalata za Word, ma spreadsheet a Excel, zowonetsera ndi zithunzi, ndikuphatikiza kukhala PDF imodzi yoyera ndi chizindikiro pa fayilo iliyonse.

strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Wosinthira waulere: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB ndi mitundu yoposa 40. Pa intaneti, palibe kulembetsa, khalidwe lapamwamba.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Wosinthira mmodzi wa mtundu uliwonse: Word kukhala PDF, PDF kukhala Word, JPG kukhala PDF, PDF kukhala JPG, Excel kukhala PDF, PowerPoint kukhala PDF, PNG kukhala JPG, EPUB kukhala PDF… Gwetzani mafayilo anu ndipo pdff imangopereka mitundu yotheka yokha.

strings.tools.diviser.intro: Tumizani gawo lofunikira la chikalata chachikulu: pdff imadula PDF yanu m'mbali zomwe mwasankha ndikubwezera zidutswazo mu fayilo ya ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Sungani masamba omwe mukufuna okha kuchokera ku PDF, kapena chotsani owonjezerawo. Pa intaneti, zaulere, palibe kulembetsa, palibe chizindikiro.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Tsamba lopanda kanthu, tsamba lopanda ntchito, lothandizira kawiri? Lembani masamba oti musunge kapena kuchotsa (mwachitsanzo 1-3, 7, 10-end) ndikupeza PDF yoyera masekondi ochepa.

strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Sintha dongosolo la masamba a PDF, pangani kopi ya ena kapena bwezeretsani chikalata chonsecho. Zaulere, pa intaneti, palibe kulembetsa.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Masamba ajambulidwa molakwika? Lembani dongosolo latsopano (mwachitsanzo 3, 1, 2, 4-end) kapena bwezeretsani chikalata chonse: pdff imachita zotsalazo.
